name: icebound-slam-on-attack-mills-five-water-gets-plus-five-power
notes: Icebound Slam (6fxxgmuesd) played by player 2 (turn 2: the opening player can't activate attack cards on turn 1) with a WATER lineage; no Class Bonus, so it costs its printed 7. Deck top after player 2's turn-start draw: five Spirit of Water (WATER) then Charge the Soul (marker: must be the new top card). On Attack mills five; five water cards in the graveyard -> +5 POWER (8 damage). Pre-fix the generated body milled with a loop of MZMove(myDeck-0), so only ONE card was milled (graveyard 2, deck 18, 3 damage).

rulesClauses: On Attack: Put the top five cards of your deck into your graveyard. Then if there are five or more water element cards in your graveyard, Icebound Slam gets +5 POWER.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. The generated onAttackAbilities["6fxxgmuesd:0"] milled five cards with a loop of MZMove($player, "myDeck-0", "myGraveyard"). Remove() only flags a slot removed (no splice), so "myDeck-0" resolved to the SAME removed slot on every iteration after the first and MZMove's "already removed" guard silently no-oped: only the top card was ever milled (live repro: graveyard 2, deck 18, no +5 POWER). Overridden in GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php with MillCards().
